title.zh: 反比例函数 · 此消彼长
title.en: Inverse Proportion · One Up, One Down

description.zh: 乘积 x·y = k 不变的关系，图像是不与坐标轴相交的双曲线。只展示 k>0、x>0 的一支。
description.en: A relation with constant product x·y = k graphs as a hyperbola that never meets the axes. Only the k > 0, x > 0 branch is shown.

reason.zh: 一次函数每步增加同样多（斜率），反比例是每步乘同样的倍数的倒数；用“比值不变 / 乘积不变”区分。
reason.en: A linear function adds the same amount each step (the slope), while inverse proportion keeps the product fixed; “constant ratio versus constant product” tells them apart.

title.zh: 怎样判断是正比例还是反比例？
title.en: How do you tell direct from inverse proportion?

ask.zh: x·y = k 不变时，x 变大，y 怎样变？画出来是直线还是曲线？
ask.en: With x·y = k fixed, when x grows, what happens to y? Does the graph come out straight or curved?

ask.zh: 正比例的图是一条过原点的直线，斜率是比值——反比例的“斜率”为什么不能这样看？
ask.en: Direct proportion graphs as a straight line through the origin whose slope is the ratio — why can't you read inverse proportion the same way?

reveal.zh: 乘积不变，一个变大另一个按比例变小，图像是双曲线；看 x·y 是否恒定就能区分正比例和反比例。
reveal.en: With the product fixed, one growing means the other shrinks in proportion, and the graph is a hyperbola; checking whether x·y stays constant tells direct from inverse proportion.
